references.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

rows.label: uncertain
rows.reason: The removal of config.i18n.fallbacks=true and replacement with a custom FallbackLocaleList is a real architectural change worth flagging, but the new initializer explicitly includes I18n::Backend::Fallbacks and sets I18n.fallbacks, so it plausibly replaces the old setting. Neither reference covers this specific concern.

rows.label: uncertain
rows.reason: The NoMethodError risk if I18n.fallbacks is not the custom class is a real concern, but the initializer always sets I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new at load time, making this scenario unlikely in practice. Neither reference matches this specific failure mode.

rows.label: match
rows.reason: Both identify that the fallback locale list uses locale values without normalization (String vs Symbol), which could cause duplicate entries or missed fallbacks — the reference explicitly calls out the need to normalize locale input to avoid double-loading when the same locale is passed as String vs Symbol.
